blurb: Guests rent kayaks and paddleboards from automated kiosks by scanning a QR code and using their smartphone. Rentals include paddles and life jackets with whistles. Locations operate mostly from sunrise to sunset with no staff on site and no reservations required.
extraNote: Late return fees vary by location; ongoing hourly rates apply after rental period · Equipment not returned within 24 hours charged full replacement cost · Group rentals available by advanced reservation subject to availability · At automated kiosks located at various parks and waterfronts, e.g., Active Recreation Area - South Shore at Timnath Reservoir, Fort Collins, CO
